purpose: Portable continuation context for autonomous development sessions.
recent_engineering_changes: GitHub-hosted runners are the primary execution environment.
Catalog and maintenance workflows use current Node-24-compatible action majors available to the repository.
Catalog and freshness publication use serialized concurrency plus rebase and force-with-lease.
Extractor preserves issuer source-page URLs and method metadata.
Generated outputs are excluded from seed ingestion to prevent recursive catalog growth.
Seed normalization preserves historical column spelling/case, including explicit free-status metadata.
Validator forbids Free status on candidate/reference/watch records.
Portable local-first progress tracker, recommender and offline site assets are present.
GitHub Pages is enabled for the repository and live deployment is verified by the deployment workflow.
Canonical prerequisite learning pathways are stored in taxonomy/pathways.json and published to the static site as data/pathways.json.
Service worker caches the pathway explorer, offline fallback and published pathway payload.
Site smoke test covers catalogue, progress, recommender, pathways and offline assets.
Repository hygiene is passing after recent cleanup.
Free-core publication is gated to explicitly promoted verified-free evidence states.
Manual promotion decisions have a documented evidence contract.
Catalog seed triggers exclude generated catalog outputs.
Catalog refresh is followed by workflow_run-triggered smoke, accessibility, asset-integrity and Pages workflows.
Reproducible release manifest records build-trigger SHA, source hashes, catalog statistics and artifact hashes, with build-trigger semantics explicitly named.
Live Pages deployment now verifies the published URL and OpenCertAtlas marker after deploy.
known_non_blocking_items: Verified-free core is intentionally small until credential-level evidence is promoted; free-price signals are not equivalent to verification.
Self-hosted runner is optional and not required for the production catalog pipeline.
The catalog is currently candidate-heavy; the next quality bottleneck is evidence promotion and credential-to-skill mapping, not raw row count.
next_priority: map verified credentials to prerequisite/skill nodes
strengthen evidence promotion with deterministic issuer-level review
expand multilingual UI coverage without translating official names
add release snapshot navigation and catalog version display
improve catalog performance as record count grows
expand official provider coverage based on source quality, not synthetic row multiplication
human_intervention: Only account-level settings, environment approval, secrets, or other privileged UI actions not exposed through repository tooling.
